items.headline: Tensions Rise as Trump Calls Iran Talks 'Last Chance' While Tehran Denies Direct Negotiations
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump warned that upcoming diplomatic talks are Iran's last opportunity to reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz after he halted planned military strikes. However, Iranian officials pushed back by denying direct negotiations with Washington, stating their discussions are currently limited to regional mediator Oman.

items.headline: Alexandra Eala Becomes First Filipino Player to Win WTA Singles Title
items.summary: Filipina tennis player Alexandra Eala made history by winning the Washington DC Open on Monday, defeating world number three Jessica Pegula 4-6, 6-4, 6-0 in a weather-delayed final. The 21-year-old's breakthrough victory marks the first time an athlete from the Philippines has won a WTA Tour singles title.

items.headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Sets Domestic Box Office Record With $360 Million Debut
items.summary: Marvel and Sony's superhero sequel Spider-Man: Brand New Day grossed $360 million in North America during its opening weekend, surpassing the record previously held by Avengers: Endgame. Sony Pictures confirmed the updated totals on August 3 after stronger-than-expected Sunday ticket sales pushed the film's global opening past $920 million.
